name: Hexnode UEM
summary: Hexnode UEM manages Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux devices. Its listed prices run from $2.20 to $4.70 per device a month across three plans, with a fourth plan on request. The pricing page does not say whether the figures are monthly or annual rates, so confirm that before budgeting.

facts.text: The Wipe Device action factory-resets a managed device and permanently erases its data, and it cannot be stopped once started.
The Lock Device action locks a managed device's screen and supports Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux.
Admins can associate policies with device groups or user groups, and the policy then applies its configurations and restrictions to the devices in those groups.
For iOS devices in Apple automated enrollment, the enrollment profile has a setting that makes the MDM profile non-removable on supervised devices.
The pricing page has a Monthly or Annually toggle and says annual billing saves 10%. The page does not show which billing period the listed prices reflect.

plans.name: Pro (MDM Essentials)
plans.notes: Includes 2 technicians. The page does not state whether this is the monthly or annual rate

plans.name: Enterprise (Advanced MDM)
plans.notes: Includes 3 technicians, directory integrations with Entra ID, Active Directory and Google Workspace

plans.name: Ultimate (UEM Essentials)
plans.notes: Includes 4 technicians, basic Okta SSO and Windows Autopilot

plans.name: Ultra (Advanced UEM)
plans.notes: Pricing on request. Includes 5 technicians, patch management and BitLocker

hiddenCosts: The page does not say whether the listed prices are monthly or annual rates, and annual billing is described as saving 10%.
The page says to start with 15 devices, but the FAQ answer on minimum licenses did not load, so the minimum is unconfirmed.
Okta SSO starts at the Ultimate plan, and Okta Device Trust is on the quote-only Ultra plan.
